summary: Today is a mixed day driven by major retail sector consolidation alongside notable judicial developments in domestic personal law and international governance litigation. Key drivers include Shalimar Paints' Rs 19,839-crore merger with Infra.Market and a key Delhi High Court ruling under the Motor Vehicles Act.

bullets.text: Shalimar Paints' board approved a Rs 19,839-crore merger with promoter Infra.Market to consolidate operations into a single BSE and NSE-listed entity.
Nexus Select Trust acquired Kolkata's Diamond Plaza Mall for Rs 355 crore, expanding its retail real estate portfolio with major commercial tenants.
The Delhi High Court held that financial dependency is not a prerequisite for married daughters or sisters to claim compensation under S. 166 MV Act.
Meta agreed to pause issuing Class C shares during pre-trial and trial proceedings in a shareholder lawsuit before the Delaware Court of Chancery.
Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Nelnet Inc. on NBS India Holding's 100% shareholding acquisition of school technology provider Entab Infotech.
